maintenance_led.reason: Sells CGM sensors and systems (Dexcom G7, Stelo) to patients; recurring sensors are consumables, not repair of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes mainly from commercial insurers, distributors, pharmacies and consumers for G7 and Stelo; government programs are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own CGM products (G7, G7 15 Day, Stelo), with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated CGM devices guide insulin dosing; switching needs a new prescription, retraining, and re-integration with pumps and apps.

notes: Public funding share is judged from general knowledge, not the website text.
